source.document: WHO SMART Guidelines — Antenatal Care (DAK L2)

regle_metier: If the woman has any of the following physical exam results, refer to the hospital

regles.action: Conduct further investigation and, if necessary, refer urgently if treatment not available at your facility
regles.annotation: Woman has a fever – provide treatment and refer urgently to hospital! Procedure: – Insert an IV line – Give fluids slowly
regles.reference: Managing complications guide (IMPAC) (2017): Section S-113 (5)

regles.annotation: Abnormal pulse rate – refer for further investigation Procedure: – Check for fever, infection, respiratory distress, arrhythmia – Refer for further investigation
regles.reference: Managing complications guide (IMPAC) (2017): Section S-1 (5)

regles.annotation: Woman has respiratory distress – refer urgently to the hospital!
regles.reference: Managing complications in pregnancy and childbirth guide (IMPAC) (2017): Section S-149 (5)

regles.sortie: "Pelvic exam result (visual)" = "Evidence of amniotic fluid" - "Gestational age" < 37 weeks
regles.annotation: Woman should be referred urgently if there is evidence of amniotic fluid, which could indicate the start of labour
regles.reference: Managing complications in pregnancy and childbirth guide (IMPAC) (2017): Sections S-51, C-91 (5)

regles.annotation: If no fetal heartbeat is observed, inform the woman that there might be a problem and that she needs to be referred to the hospital for further examination and next steps.  Procedure: – Inform the woman that you cannot find the heartbeat and need to refer her to check if there's a problem – Refer to hospital
regles.reference: Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care guide (IMPAC) (2015): C7 (1)

regles.annotation: Fetal heart rate is abnormal after two readings: the woman should be referred to hospital
regles.reference: Pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum and newborn care guide (IMPAC) (2015): C7 (1)
